Metadata.description: A club and platform for the car community: garage, meets and badges for attendance.

Home.title: Your car. Your garage. Your club.
Home.subtitle: Tuning, youngtimers, American cars, classics and bikes. Garage, meets and attendance badges in one place.
Home.featureGarageText: All your cars and bikes on one profile.
Home.featureEventsText: Apply for events and get approved by the organizer.
Home.featureBadgesText: For every verified attendance at a meet.
